messages.content: "Can you help me calculate the compound interest for my savings? I initially invested $5000 as the principal amount. The bank offers an annual interest rate of 2.5%. I plan to keep my money in the bank for 10 years. Also, the interest is compounded quarterly, so it's compounded 4 times in a year. Can you calculate the compound interest I would get for the first 2 years, first 3 years and first 5 years?"

function.name: calculate_compound_interest
function.description: Calculate compound interest for an initial principal amount. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The principal amount that the interest is applied to.

rate.description: The annual interest rate. Enter as a decimal. E.g, 5% is 0.05 This is a float type value.

time.description: The time the money is invested for in years.

n.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per time period. Default is 1.

message.content:
**Compound‑interest formula**

\[
A = P\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}
\]

* \(P\) – principal (initial deposit)  
* \(r\) – annual nominal interest rate (decimal)  
* \(n\) – number of compounding periods per year  
* \(t\) – time in years  
* \(A\) – amount after \(t\) years  
* Compound interest earned = \(A-P\)

---

### Given

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
| \(P\) | \$5 000 |
| \(r\) | 2.5 % = **0.025** |
| \(n\) | 4 (quarterly) |
| \(t\) | 2, 3, 5 years (separately) |

---

### 1. First 2 years

\[
\begin{aligned}
A_{2} &= 5000\left(1+\frac{0.025}{4}\right)^{4\times 2} \\
      &= 5000\left(1+0.00625\right)^{8} \\
      &= 5000(1.00625)^{8} \\
      &\approx 5000 \times 1.05107 \\
      &\approx \$5\,255.35
\end{aligned}
\]

Compound interest earned:

\[
I_{2}=A_{2}-P \approx 5\,255.35-5\,000 = \boxed{\$255.35}
\]

---

### 2. First 3 years

\[
\begin{aligned}
A_{3} &= 5000\left(1+0.00625\right)^{12} \\
      &\approx 5000 \times 1.07758 \\
      &\approx \$5\,387.90
\end{aligned}
\]

Compound interest earned:

\[
I_{3}=A_{3}-P \approx 5\,387.90-5\,000 = \boxed{\$387.90}
\]

---

### 3. First 5 years

\[
\begin{aligned}
A_{5} &= 5000\left(1+0.00625\right)^{20} \\
      &\approx 5000 \times 1.13261 \\
      &\approx \$5\,663.05
\end{aligned}
\]

Compound interest earned:

\[
I_{5}=A_{5}-P \approx 5\,663.05-5\,000 = \boxed{\$663.05}
\]

---

#### Summary

| Time | Final amount | Compound interest earned |
|------|--------------|---------------------------|
| 2 yr | \$5 255.35   | **\$255.35** |
| 3 yr | \$5 387.90   | **\$387.90** |
| 5 yr | \$5 663.05   | **\$663.05** |

These figures assume the interest rate stays constant at 2.5 % per year and is compounded quarterly throughout the period.
